name: Python Static Security Analysis (compliance rendition)
description: Run Bandit static security analysis over the InTrust tool layer to identify insecure coding patterns before release. Reported for regulatory traceability.

reporting.expectedOutput: Obligations this run evidenced, obligations it did not, the method and thresholds applied, and every stated limit on scope

notes: Sibling of sample_intent_python_scan_technical.json with the same target and parameters. The four criteria exercise all three coverage statuses against the bandit-static-code skill: 'iso27001' resolves to assessed (evidence bearing on 3 of its 6 recorded requirements), 'nis2' to assessed (2 of 5), 'linddun' to declaredNotAssessed since no requirement recorded under it is evaluable by a static code scanner, and 'internal_secure_coding_policy:v3' to unrecognised since it is not in the ontology. regulatoryCoverage.complete is therefore false. The assessed/unassessed split is the point: 3 of 6 is what this run evidenced, and reporting only the 3 would read as coverage of the standard.
